notice: Every amount, quota and fee in this catalog is a clearly marked placeholder (TBD). No payment is collected. Do not treat these figures as a real offer or invoice. Local V/X (verify_journal) is free. Certified proofs (certify_note / verify_proof) are the paid feature: they already run locally (FreeTSA test mode, or qualified eIDAS with the operator's own Certigna account), but XVcache's hosted certified witness and its price are TBD.

now.note: When billing is enabled, the agent must show the plan to its human and obtain explicit approval. The intended path is a Stripe checkout link. No link is live today.

reseller.note: An agent or agent-builder may later resell or bundle XVcache for its own clients. Partner terms, revenue share and limits are TBD. Nothing is offered or signed today.

certified_proofs.model: One timestamp covers a Merkle root of many notes (tampon groupé); each note gets its own proof (preuve vendue à l'unité).

layers.A: RFC 3161 token: qualified eIDAS only when a qualified TSA (Certigna) is configured; FreeTSA default is test, non qualifié.
layers.B: OpenTimestamps anchor of the same root (public, Bitcoin, pending for a few hours).
